jobs.occupation: Erfaren hemstädare/ Experienced Home cleaner - Hemfrid Norsborg
jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER HEMSTÄDARE– BLI EN DEL AV VÅRT TEAM!
Vill du ha ett jobb där du verkligen gör skillnad i människors vardag? Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, fönsterputs och andra tjänster i hemmet, alltid med kvalitet och omtanke.
Nu söker vi dig som vill arbeta som städare. Hos oss blir du en del av ett internationellt team med kollegor från hela världen, tillsammans levererar vi service i världsklass!
Vad erbjuder vi?
· En tjänst på 75 %
· Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor
· Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad
· Milersättning mellan kunder för dig som kör egen bil i tjänst
· Betalt restid mellan kunderna
· Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension)
· Vi värnar om din hälsa! Därför erbjuder vi ett friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år
· Gratis mobilabonnemang
· Kostnadsfri utbildning i hemstädning samt vidareutbildningar inom service och städning
· Field Lead/Buddy – kontaktperson inom städning samt stöd till medarbetare ute på fältet
· Teamträffar och gemensamma fester
Hos oss får du rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas. Har du viljan, så ger vi dig verktygen för att briljera!

Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som:
· Tycker om att arbeta både självständigt och i team
· Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och engagerad
· Vill utvecklas och lära dig mer
· Talar svenska eller engelska
· Kan arbeta flexibla arbetstider (måndag–fredag kl. 08.00–17.00)
· Är flexibel och trivs med att arbeta hos olika kunder
Meriterande:
· B-körkort (egen bil är ett plus)
· Erfarenhet av städning eller serviceyrken

Utvecklingsmöjligheter inom Hemfrid Inom vår kollektivverksamhet finns flera olika roller och utvecklingsvägar. Vårt mål är att alla medarbetare ska få möjlighet att lära sig, utvecklas och växa inom Hemfrid. Genom erfarenhet, utbildning och nya ansvarsområden kan du steg för steg utvecklas och ta dig an nya roller inom företaget.

Ansök redan idag! Läs mer på www.hemfrid.se/karriar och ansök  Har du frågor? Kontakta oss gärna på hr@hemfrid.se
Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! ✨

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR HOME CLEANERS – JOIN OUR TEAM!
Do you want a job where you truly make a difference in people’s everyday lives?
Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a cleaner and surrounding areas. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world. Together, we deliver world-class service!
What do we offer?
· A 75% position
· Collective agreement and secure employment terms
· Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month
· Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work
· Paid travel time between customers
· Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)
· We care about your health! That’s why we offer a wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year
· Free mobile phone subscription
· Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning
· Field Lead/Buddy – point of contact and support for team members in the field on cleaning operations.
· Team meetings and social events
With us, you get the right conditions to succeed. If you have the motivation, we will give you the tools to excel!

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who:
· Enjoys working both independently and in a team
· Is detail-oriented, responsible, and committed
· Wants to grow and develop
· Speaks Swedish or English
· Can work flexible hours (Monday–Friday between 08:00–17:00)
· Is flexible and enjoys working with different customers
Meritorious:
· B driver’s license (own car is a plus)
· Experience in cleaning or service-related jobs
Development Opportunities at Hemfrid Within our collective workforce, there are several different roles and career paths. Our goal is to give every employee the opportunity to learn, develop, and grow within Hemfrid. Through experience, training, and increased responsibilities, you can develop step by step and take on new roles within the company.
Apply today! Read more at www.hemfrid.se/karriar and apply  If you have questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se
We look forward to hearing from you! ✨

Ready to modernize, optimize, and scale hybrid cloud infrastructure in an international engineering environment? On behalf of our client, Axiomatics, Academic Work is looking for a Platform Engineer in Stockholm. Here, you will play a central role in maintaining and evolving CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes environments, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and observability for a global leader in dynamic authorization. Apply today as we review applications on an ongoing basis!
About the role
Axiomatics is a global leader in dynamic authorization and attribute-based access control (ABAC). Founded in Stockholm with a strong international presence across Europe and North America, Axiomatics delivers enterprise-grade authorization solutions that help organizations protect sensitive data and enable Zero Trust architectures across finance, healthcare, and the public sector.
Together with Axiomatics, Academic Work is looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen their engineering organization in Stockholm. In this role, you will take ownership of building, maintaining, and modernizing the core platform and hybrid infrastructure (AWS and on-premises) that supports their product development teams. Collaborating closely with internal product squads and engineering leads across international teams, you will streamline CI/CD workflows, drive Infrastructure as Code adoption, and ensure high reliability and observability so developers can ship software faster and more safely.
You are offered:
The opportunity to work at an innovative, global software company with deep technical expertise.
A key technical role with high ownership over hybrid cloud, platform reliability, and CI/CD automation.
An international, collaborative engineering culture in central Stockholm.

 
Work tasks
In this role, you will own and evolve the platform that enables Axiomatics’ engineering teams to build, test, and ship software smoothly and securely. Your main responsibilities include:
Cloud, Kubernetes & IaC: Manage, scale, and modernize AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) environments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), including container lifecycles, Helm deployments, and access controls.
Hybrid CI/CD & Artifacts: Build, maintain, and optimize automated pipelines connecting cloud repositories (GitHub/GitLab) with on-premises Jenkins and artifact storage.
Quality, Security & Observability: Integrate automated code quality and vulnerability scanning into the CI/CD workflow, and maintain platform observability to ensure pipeline and infrastructure health.
Developer Experience & Collaboration: Partner with product squads to troubleshoot bottlenecks, build internal tooling/sandboxes that speed up daily work, and share DevSecOps best practices across the team.

We are looking for
Cloud, Kubernetes & IaC: Solid hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure and container orchestration—ideally AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) (such as Helm charts and container lifecycles)—combined with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar). (We are also open to strong equivalent experience from Azure/AKS or similar container platforms with an interest in deepening your AWS skills).
CI/CD & Automation: Proven experience administering and building CI/CD pipelines (such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), including dynamic agents/runners, build caching, and artifact repositories (like JFrog Artifactory or similar).
Quality, Security & Observability: Experience integrating automated code analysis, testing, or vulnerability scanning tools (such as SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, or similar) into CI/CD, combined with solid cloud security basics (IAM, least-privilege access) and experience with observability/monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or OpenTelemetry).
Modern Workflow: Familiarity with using modern AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering workflow to streamline scripting, debugging, and automation.
Language: Fluency in English, both spoken and written, as it is the primary working language across the organization.

It is meritorious if you have:
Experience building runtime sandboxes or tooling for AI coding agents and LLM-driven test loops (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).
Experience working in a product-driven enterprise software or cybersecurity company.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Problem-solving and analytical
Structured and thorough
Collaborative and communicative
Proactive and self-driven

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

At Silex Microsystems, we are expanding our Test Engineering team to support a growing initiative in photonic MEMS - combining optical functionality with microelectromechanical structures. We are looking for a curious, hands-on engineer at the start of their career who wants to combine photonics, semiconductor technology, and experimental work. This is an opportunity to help develop test solutions from early research and development through to production, while learning from experienced colleagues.
Read more about Silex here.
About the role
You will help develop and operate test setups for optical and electro-optical characterization of MEMS devices. Working closely with an experienced optics and waveguide specialist as your mentor, you will contribute your knowledge of photonics and semiconductor technology while building practical test-engineering skills. 
Your work will connect laboratory measurements with device behaviour and engineering decisions. As you gain experience, you will take increasing ownership of test methods, setups and technical investigations. 
Your responsibilities will include: 

Developing electrical, optical and electro-optical test systems, including building and aligning test setups, verifying system performance, commissioning systems for production and making continuous improvements. 

Characterizing devices at the chip and wafer level.

Developing measurement automation and data analysis tools. 

Investigating unexpected results and distinguishing device behaviour from measurement system effects. 

Evaluating repeatability and documenting test methods, conditions and results. 

Collaborating with colleagues across Test Engineering internal and external project teams as well as suppliers. 

Your background
You have, or are completing, a MSc or PhD in photonics, engineering physics, nanotechnology, electrical engineering or a related field. If you enjoy hands-on experiments and want to turn academic knowledge into practical test solutions, we would love to hear from you.
We are looking for someone who:

Has a foundation in photonics, semiconductor technology or MEMS, and an interest in understanding how devices work.

Enjoys and has experience in hands-on experiments and measurements, e.g. gained through a thesis work, university projects, research or an early industry role.

Has an interest in programming for measurement control, automation and data analysis, for example using Python or LabVIEW.

Has a curious, careful approach to problem-solving, a willingness to ask questions and an enthusiasm for learning with colleagues.

Has the ability to communicate effectively in English and share findings with colleagues from different technical backgrounds.

In addition to above it will be considered highly meritorious if you have experience with integrated optics, optoelectronic devices or microfabrication. Practical skills in cleanroom work, mechanical design, including CAD modelling and manufacturing, or electronics design, including basic circuits and printed circuit boards (PCBs), are also valuable.
What we offer you

A role supporting a growing area of photonic MEMS development. 

Opportunities to work with cutting-edge MEMS technology in a state-of-the-art environment.

Individual mentoring from an experienced optics and waveguide specialist. 

The opportunity to combine photonics with semiconductor technology, instrumentation and automation. 

Practical responsibility for experiments and test setups, with support as you develop. 

A path towards independent technical ownership within Test Engineering. 

About Silex
Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS is present in nearly all modern technology, from personal gadgets to automotive electronics, medical monitoring and testing equipment, and thermal management systems. With a team of expert engineers, operators, technicians, support staff, specialists, and more, Silex brings the ideas and concepts of the industry’s leading MEMS innovators to life.
The Silex team brings together talented, curious, visionary, and determined individuals to break new ground in the industry alongside customers, developing the latest process technology within MEMS for global applications. As part of this team, you will work with some of the world’s largest technology giants and innovation leaders in industries such as medicine, life sciences, consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive, and industrial sectors.
The recruitment process
We have an ongoing recruitment process and therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test as well as reference checks. Additionally, we will conduct a background check and drug test prior to employment, and as an employer, we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.

Want real-world experience in finance and sales while you study? Join BRF Finans, Odevo’s newly launched, regulated loan and insurance brokerage, as a part-time Sales Administrator and help shape the business from day one in a fast paced, AI driven environment. The role starts in December, so apply today!
About the role
Our client, Odevo is on a mission to become the leading international force in residential  property management. What we do matters to millions of people in their everyday  lives. 
Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying  a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long,  residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents'  expectations, and the industry is ready for change.  
Odevo is now looking for a student who wants to be part of that change. As Sales  Administrator at BRF Finans, you will work closely with the Loan and Insurance  Procurement Specialists and keep the procurement processes moving, from leads to  requesting quotations to compiling the data behind every recommendation. The role  involves close collaboration with Odevo’s financial advisors, insurance broker and  banking partners. Your work helps customers get clear, well-founded advice on  important financial decisions. 
You will learn quickly and see how the business is built from the inside. Once you’re  up to speed, you’ll have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility.  
If you’re an experienced AI user or take a thoughtful approach to exploring how it  can make work smarter, we’d love to hear how. 
Work tasks
Keep track of incoming leads and support loan and insurance  advisors throughout the procurement process.   
Ensure that client enquiries are addressed promptly and that no tasks or follow-ups  fall through the cracks.   
Request quotations from banks when new customer agreements come in.  
Track ongoing procurements and follow up on outstanding quotations.  
Compile and structure incoming quotations to support the  specialist's advice to customers.  
Collect updated quotations once negotiations are complete   
Compile and analyse data and statistics

We are looking for
Ongoing university studies of at least 50%
Availability 2–3 days per week for an initial four month period 
Previous experience in administrative or service work 
The ability to quickly learn and confidently use new digital tools 
Excellent written and spoken Swedish and English

It is considered an advantage if you have:
Sales experience, ideally in loans or financial services, though all  sales experience counts 
Experience working with homeowners’ associations, either in a  client facing capacity or as a board member.

To succeed in this role, you have the following personal qualities:
Structured and organized: You keep track of multiple cases,  know where each one stands and what comes next, and plan  your days so nothing stalls. 
Detail-oriented: You check figures and documents carefully,  spot what doesn’t add up, and make sure the specialist can rely  on what you deliver. 
Responsible and reliable: You follow up without being  reminded, keep your commitments, and flag potential issues  early, keeping everyone informed along the way. 
Curious and proactive: You ask questions when something is  unclear, look for smarter ways of working, and take the initiative  to move things forward. 
Service-minded and collaborative: You communicate clearly,  listen closely, and build trusted relationships with customers,  banks, insurance partners and colleagues. You take pride in  making things easier for others and helping the team succeed.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process. To join us in a part-time role, you’ll need another main activity that covers at least 50% of your time. That could be studies, another job, running your own business, parental leave, or something similar.

Project Controls Manager 
The European Spallation Source (ESS) will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science. 
We are now looking for a Project Controls Manager to oversee the operational and development project scope at ESS.  
 
About the role: 
The Project Controls Manager (PCM) plays a critical role in ensuring the best use of the human and financial resources for the ESS organisation. They are responsible for establishing and maintaining the systems, processes, and governance needed to plan, monitor, and control organisational performance and the ESS programme. The role provides leadership across planning and scheduling, cost control, risk management, change control, and reporting to support informed decision-making and successful delivery. Working closely with project managers, technical leads, finance, procurement, operations, and other stakeholders, the PCM will have a central overview of both the operational and development project scope. 
This is a permanent role based at ESS campus in Lund, Sweden.  
 
Day-to-day, you will: 
Supervise a team managing cost control, planning, risk, change control and reporting functions.  
Lead the development, maintenance, and governance of integrated schedules using Primavera P6. This includes long term strategic planning, shutdown planning and development project planning.  
Establish baseline schedules, progress measurement methods, and schedule update routines to support accurate forecasting and performance tracking.  
Establish yearly budgets, cost reports, forecasts, and performance metrics.  
Monitor actual cost and commitments against budget and forecast, identifying trends, variances, and corrective actions.  
Implement and maintain project risk management processes, including risk identification (threats and opportunities), assessment, mitigation planning, and monitoring.  
Manage project change control processes to ensure that scope, schedule, cost, and risk impacts are properly assessed, approved, and recorded.  
Prepare and issue regular project controls reports, dashboards, and management summaries for key stakeholders.  
Support decision-making through scenario analysis, performance insight, and timely escalation of issues and risks.  
Ensure alignment and consistency between planning, cost, risk, and reporting data across the project controls function.  
Collaborate with project managers, work package owners, finance, procurement, and contractors to maintain robust project controls.  
Contribute to continuous improvement of project controls standards, tools, templates, and governance. 

 
About you: 
University degree in engineering, science, project management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
Proven experience in project controls within large-scale technical, scientific, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering environments. 
Proven experience leading and supervising multidisciplinary teams across planning, cost control, risk, change control, and reporting functions. 
Experience establishing and managing project budgets, forecasts, cost reporting, and performance metrics. 
Solid understanding of project governance, risk management, change control, and project lifecycle management principles. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, assess risks, and support decision-making. 
Demonstrated ability to take initiative, and drive actions in a complex stakeholder environment. 
Proven ability to lead, motivate, and supervise teams while fostering collaboration and accountability. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing reports and presenting information to diverse stakeholders. 
Ability to work effectively in an international, multidisciplinary environment with multiple technical and operational interfaces. 

 
To apply: 
Working at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer market competitive, individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary. 
If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “Apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website. 
For further information regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Louise Jönegård at louise.jonegard@ess.eu.  
For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on mailto:erusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at mailto:marc.kickulies@ess.eu

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Position in Innovation & Family Business at the House of Innovation
jobs.description:
The role
The House of Innovation (HoI) invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral position primarily within a research project examining how ownership structure and family involvement shape innovation and firms' participation in internationalization, particularly amid geographical tensions and their impact on global networks. There will also be opportunities to contribute to other research projects within the Center for Family Enterprise at House of Innovation. 
The successful candidate will join a research team within a dynamic research environment and work at the intersection of family business, innovation, international business, strategy, and research policy. The main project associated with this postdoc position focuses particularly on family-controlled firms, investigating how governance and ownership influence firms’ innovation in the context of geographic and technological reach, access to external knowledge, and responses to geopolitical shocks. The position will be based at the House of Innovation and involve collaboration with Professors Mattias Nordqvist and Valentina Tartari, as well as other members of the project team, including Marco Mismetti and Lorenzo Palladini.  
Your profile
The ideal candidate will have developed a clear research agenda during their PhD and be motivated to collaborate on publications aimed at leading international journals. The position offers opportunities to pursue new research questions using unique and large-scale quantitative data, as well as qualitative methods. There will be opportunities to teach and to engage with practice through our ample network of family business owners, leaders and advisors. 
A background with experience and high proficiency in either qualitative empirical methods or quantitative empirical methods is mandatory. Priority will be given to candidates with research relevant to the topics above. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement. We expect the candidate to live in or relocate to Stockholm. 
Applicants must hold a PhD by the start of employment. To be eligible, they must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the start of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply.
How to apply: 
Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform. To apply, please submit the following documents: 
A curriculum vitae 
A cover letter articulating the candidate’s fit with the position description, including research interests and teaching experience.
A separate document listing both published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals.
Copies of representative research.
Names and contact information for three persons willing to provide references. 

Your application should be received by December 23, 2026 (CET). 
For questions about the position, please contact Mattias Nordqvist (Mattias.Nordqvist@hhs.se) 
For HR-related questions, please contact Elma Jacobson (Elma.Jacobson@hhs.se) 
About the House of Innovation (HoI) 
The House of Innovation provides an excellent, interdisciplinary environment for research, education, outreach and venturing, with scholars working in Technology and Innovation Management, Entrepreneurship, Information Systems, Operations and Supply Chain Management, and adjacent fields. HoI collaborates with a broad, influential network of academics, corporations, government agencies, and civil society actors, with the aim to contribute to the advancement of society. HoI hosts an expanding group of international scholars with currently 8 professors, 6 associate professors, 16 tenure-track assistant professors, 17 PhD students and more than 35 research fellows and postdocs. Our researchers have access to important national research networks, such as WASP-HS, and are highly successful in publishing and grant acquisition, for example, with a recent major research grant on AI in healthcare. 
HoI faculty members regularly publish in top journals, and serve on editorial boards, in editorial positions, and in academic leadership positions. They frequently receive substantial grants from leading Swedish and European funding institutions to conduct state-of-the-art research, and serve on national and international policy committees, thus contributing to the shaping of society and of innovation ecosystems.  
HoI encompasses the academic Department of Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Technology, the Jacob and Marcus Wallenberg Center for Innovative and Sustainable Business Development, the Scania Center for Innovation and Operational Excellence, The Center for Family Enterprise, The Center for Transformative Innovation, Center for Data Analytics, the research platform on innovation and sustainability within the House of Sustainable Society, and the Swedish Center for Digital Innovation (SCDI Sthlm). We also run the SSE Business Lab start-up incubator and coordinate SSE’s involvement in the Stockholm School of Entrepreneurship (SSES), a consortium with the six major universities in Stockholm providing innovation and entrepreneurship education across the wider Stockholm area and beyond.

Department of Ecology
Laboratory Engineer
We are looking for a professional with hands-on research experience and leadership skills to lead a laboratory on terrestrial ecosystem ecology at the Department of Ecology. The laboratory focuses on studying the biogeochemistry of natural and managed ecosystem, with special emphasis on isotopic analyses (13C and 14C) to study the cycling of carbon in the terrestrial biosphere. This laboratory will specialize in the collection of samples from different terrestrial ecosystems and will process samples for subsequent submission to specialized isotopic laboratories. This laboratory will support scientific studies on the interactions between the terrestrial biosphere and the climate system, and the timescales of response of the terrestrial carbon cycle to anthropogenic perturbations.
About the position
As a laboratory engineer, you will oversee the day-to-day operations of sample collection, processing, delivery to other laboratories, and archival of samples. You will be in charge of organizing and conducting sampling campaigns, supervising users of the laboratory, and building a sample archive with a corresponding database. More specifically, the main duties include:
Establishing and managing a laboratory for processing of environmental samples (plants, soil, air) for isotopic analyses. During the first months of employment, the main tasks include the purchasing and installation of basic laboratory equipment.
Organizing and conducting fieldwork activities for the collection of environmental samples in remote national and international locations.
Processing of samples in the laboratory, which includes drying, sieving, grinding, storing, and delivering samples to other laboratories for isotope analyses.
Creating and managing a sample archive with a corresponding database.
Training and supervising researchers in the use of the laboratory.
Being responsible for maintaining safety standards in the laboratory.

You will be part of the Ecosystem Ecology unit at the Department of Ecology. You will work with a team of senior and junior researchers, providing support for laboratory and fieldwork activities. You will also interact with other laboratory personnel internally at SLU and at other institutions in Sweden and abroad.
Your profile
Requirements:
Higher education degree in environmental sciences, biology, ecology, forestry or related discipline.
Experience with field collection and laboratory processing of environmental samples.
Ability to travel nationally and internationally to remote locations for periods of 1–4 weeks at a time, with flexibility regarding travel schedules.
Ability to communicate in English and Swedish.
Very good communication and team working skills.
Capacity to work independently.
A valid Swedish drivers license (B)

Merit:
Experience with measurements of greenhouse gases and isotopes.
Experience working with databases and the R programming language.
Familiarity with concepts on the terrestrial carbon cycle.
Familiarity with the use of radiocarbon for the study of the terrestrial carbon cycle.

About us
At the Department of Ecology in Uppsala, research and education are conducted with a focus on sustainable forestry and agricultural production, as well as effective nature conservation. We study the impacts of land-use and climate change on animals, plants, soil nutrient status, and greenhouse gas balances. Our work aims to find solutions that help mitigate ongoing climate change, conserve threatened species, promote biodiversity and ecosystem services, and manage pests—both in forest and agricultural landscapes and in urban environments.
Read more about the department here: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/ecology/
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/
Location:
Uppsala.
Form of employment:
Permanent employment. SLU may apply a probationary employment period.
Scope:
100%.
Start date:
As agreed.
Application:
Please submit your application before deadline 2027-01-08. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.
Union representatives:
https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/
 
 
The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.occupation: Technical Product Owner – Embedded Software & Power Electronics
jobs.description:
This is your chance to become a Product Owner at a global leader in water technology! Whether you already have experience as a Product Owner or are an engineer ready to take the next step into product ownership, we are looking for you on behalf of our client in Stockholm. 
Here, you will take technical ownership of innovative variable frequency drives that optimize critical industrial systems worldwide. 
About the role
Our client is a global and leading technology company within water technology. At their R&D center in Stockholm, you will become part of a growing team of ten people, consisting of embedded developers, motor control specialists, and an experienced Product Owner who will support you during your onboarding. The team develops software and system integration for advanced Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) with embedded software and power electronics (230–400V AC) that control industrial pumps and mixers—a relatively new technology in the industry where you get to work at the cutting edge.
In this role, you will act as the vital link between business needs, customer requirements, and technical product development. Rather than just sitting behind a desk, you will work hands-on in the lab environment connecting equipment, such as three-phase power, and conducting tests together with the developers. You will collaborate closely with Product Management, the development team, production, support, purchasing, and external suppliers, as well as investigate complex support cases that first-line support cannot resolve.
You are offered
A thorough introduction and onboarding alongside an experienced Product Owner in the team.
A varied and practical role that combines strategic product ownership with hands-on lab work within motor control technology.
A flexible workplace with the possibility of hybrid work.

Work tasks
Product ownership and backlog: Own, prioritize, and manage the product backlog for one or more VFD products, and drive agile workflows (Scrum/Kanban) and releases together with the development team.
Requirements and roadmap: Collaborate closely with Product Management regarding the product roadmap and translate customer, market, and business needs into clear technical requirements and documentation.
Hands-on lab work: Work practically in the lab environment by assembling and connecting electrical equipment (such as three-phase connections) and performing tests with support from the developers.
Technical troubleshooting and support: Investigate escalated support cases, troubleshoot complex product behavior, and ensure knowledge transfer to internal teams and service technicians.
Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with production, Operations, and purchasing to support industrialization, quality assurance, and production improvements.

We are looking for
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, preferably within mechatronics, electrical engineering, electronics, embedded systems, or an equivalent field.
At least 1–2 years of relevant work experience from an industry-related role where you have gained experience with software-driven products, electrical systems, or technical product development.

Previous experience as a Product Owner or a strong understanding of what a Product Owner does and the readiness to take the next step.
Basic to solid understanding of how electricity and power electronics work (230–240V, energy conversion/frequency conversion) as well as how hardware interacts with embedded software, electric motors, and control theory.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. 
 You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. 
 The Infrastructure Operations organization is seeking an exceptional leader to serve as a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Cluster Manager in Sweden. You will lead a large organization managing multiple data centers in the cluster, overseeing managers responsible for critical facility infrastructure. 
 The pace, scale, and growth of Amazon's data center platform will challenge you. We seek experienced senior leaders who are highly strategic in managing their business unit, yet lead by example and roll up their sleeves when required. 
 The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of data center and mission-critical MEP infrastructure. You will be responsible for maintaining 100% service uptime in our cluster, maintaining a high-level view while diving deep into details as needed. You will interact daily with global teams, representing Sweden Data Center Engineering Operations. 
 If you are passionate about customer experience, think and act globally, and want to contribute to the operational excellence of AWS data centers, this is the challenge you've been looking for. 
Key job responsibilities 
 Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and develop the operations management team including Facility Managers, Chief Engineers, and Facility Technicians. Mentor and develop employees at all levels, including managers. 
 Operational Excellence: Ensure operation and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for AWS data centers, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and change management. Maintain 100% service uptime across your cluster. 
 Performance Management: Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of critical facility operations and maintenance. Manage all facility-related repairs in a timely manner. 
 Organizational Structure: Build and maintain a sustainable organizational structure. Develop hiring strategy and participate in recruiting events. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with business development, engineering, and construction teams to forecast staffing needs and maintain appropriate resource levels. 
 Vendor Management: Manage colocation data center service providers to meet or exceed contracted performance SLAs. Oversee on-site management of shift technicians, senior shift technicians, sub-contractors, and vendors, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with established practices and procedures. 
 Incident Management: Lead safety, security, and availability incident response, incident management, incident resolution, and root cause analysis. 
 Financial Management: Manage cost including OPEX and CAPEX associated with all data centers under your responsibility. 
 Reporting & Communication: Conduct daily/weekly/monthly Data Center Engineering Operations meetings and reporting. Run weekly availability meetings and report outcomes. 
 Global Integration: Liaise with global teams on initiatives, processes, and procedures; implement those initiatives locally in Sweden. 
 Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement of operational processes, procedures, methods, and tools. Lead and manage energy efficiency initiatives in your cluster. 
 Capacity Planning: Support capacity planning and management activities. 
About the team 
 You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Basic qualifications
Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams.
4+ years of experience operating as a manager of managers AND/OR 7+ years of relevant experience managing mission-critical facilities.
In-depth knowledge of data center facilities such as generators, chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, UPS, electrical sub-distribution systems, fire detection and suppression systems, and cable reticulation systems.
Fluency in English to communicate effectively with global teams.
Driving license valid in EU.

Preferred qualifications
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or related fields.
Experience managing or implementing system health, performance monitoring, capacity planning, or process improvement and automation.
Experience supporting procedures for production or mission-critical environments including ticketing, monitoring/metrics, and troubleshooting technical issues.
Fluency in Swedish.

Job description: 
 About the role:  
Are you an experienced credit professional with a strong analytical mindset and the ability to independently assess complex credit risks? Do you enjoy combining financial analysis and risk management with digital development and continuous improvement? Are you motivated by taking ownership, influencing decisions, and contributing to a strong credit culture? Then this could be the opportunity for you!At Volvo Financial Services, we are looking for a Senior Credit & Risk Analyst to strengthen our team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will play a key part in assessing and managing credit risk, supporting sound business decisions, and continuously improving the way we work. You will combine hands-on credit analysis with portfolio controlling, reporting, and the development of smarter, more scalable solutions.
 What you will do 
As Senior Credit & Risk Analyst, you will take an independent role in assessing complex credit cases and providing well-founded recommendations to support business decisions. You will prepare credit applications for larger transactions presented to relevant Credit Committees, ensuring high-quality financial analysis and clear recommendation rationale.You will also underwrite new business within your individual credit delegation and act as a voting member of various Credit Committees. Through your expertise and judgement, you will contribute to maintaining a sound risk balance while supporting the business and its customers.
 Beyond your core credit responsibilities, you will play an important role in developing and improving our credit and risk processes. You will drive the development and implementation of automated and scalable credit analysis and reporting solutions, leveraging AI, Power BI, and other data and analytics tools.
 You will also contribute to the design and maintenance of Swedish underwriting directives and procedures, ensuring alignment with relevant internal and external frameworks. In addition, you will support monthly and quarterly Credit & Risk reporting and contribute to the continuous quality assurance of our processes.
 We are a small team where collaboration, flexibility, and a willingness to support one another are essential. This means being comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities while also contributing to other activities and tasks across the team when needed.
 Who are you? 
You are a proactive and structured professional who enjoys taking ownership and driving things forward independently. You have a strong analytical mindset and the confidence to make sound credit assessments, even in complex situations. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying potential risks, and translating financial data into clear and well-founded recommendations.You combine strong financial and analytical capabilities with a genuine interest in digitalization and innovation. You are curious about how new technologies, particularly AI, can improve the way we work, and you enjoy identifying opportunities to make processes more efficient, automated, and scalable.
 As a person, you are collaborative and business-oriented. You understand the importance of balancing risk management with commercial priorities and maintaining a strong focus on customers. You communicate clearly, involve relevant stakeholders, and enjoy working together to achieve shared results.
 You thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where being flexible, solution-oriented, and willing to learn is just as important as your technical expertise.
 To join us, we see that you have:• A university degree or MBA in Finance, Controlling, or a related field, or equivalent experience.• Solid experience in hands-on credit risk assessment and management within the financial services industry.• The ability to independently conduct complex credit analyses and provide well-founded credit recommendations.• Strong financial analysis and quantitative skills, with the ability to assess financial statements and evaluate credit risk.• Strong digital capabilities and experience using data and analytics tools, with an interest in incorporating AI into credit analysis and everyday workflows.• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Swedish.• Strong organizational skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to manage your own responsibilities independently.• A collaborative mindset, with the ability to coordinate, involve, and work effectively with different stakeholders.
 Ready for the next move?

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that contribute to quality enhancement and cost efficiency within healthcare and life sciences. We employ more than 10,000 people, and have operations in more than 40 countries. Saving lives is the greatest job in the world. Everything we do, from architectural planning to the equipment, therapies and solutions aim to secure the safest and most reliable care. As a leading medtech company, we focus every talent and resource towards helping our customers save as many lives as possible.
Job description:About this opportunity  
  
 As Regulatory Affairs Specialist at Getinge Disinfection, you provide regulatory compliance and ensure successful product compliance for R&D and sustaining projects and changes. You also perform and support product registrations and improve the process.
 You report to the Regulatory Affairs Manager and work closely with R&D, Technical Support, Production, Sourcing and management, as well as with the Regulatory and Product Compliance organization and authorities in different countries.
  
 In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide regulatory compliance and ensure successful product compliance for R&D and sustaining projects and changes.
  
  
 What you will do
  
  As a Regulatory Affairs Specialist at Getinge, you will play an important role in ensuring that our medical devices meet regulatory requirements throughout their lifecycle, from product development to market registration and post-market changes.
  
 Your main tasks will include:
  Prepare, compile, review, and support regulatory submissions for new product registrations, renewals, and amendments across international markets.
 Maintain existing regulatory approvals, licenses, and registrations and ensure renewals and regulatory updates are completed on time.
 Develop and support regulatory strategies for new product development projects, working closely with R&D, Quality, and other cross-functional teams.
 Assess the regulatory impact of product and design changes, including engineering change requests and change control activities
 Review and maintain regulatory technical documentation, including technical files, Design History Files (DHF), risk management documentation, and verification and validation records
 Monitor changes in international medical-device regulations, standards, and guidance and assess potential impact to existing and future products.
 Support regulatory information management systems and maintain accurate product registration data
 Review and approve product labeling, Instructions for Use (IFUs), and marketing materials to ensure regulatory compliance.
  
 
 This position is located in Växjö with the possibility to work 1-2 days from home. The role may require domestic and international travel.
  
  
 You will bring
  
 To be successful in this position, we believe that you have the following qualifications.
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Management or a related discipline.
 Experience in Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, product development, or a related function within the medical device industry or another regulated environment.
 Experience with regulatory submissions, technical documentation, product registrations, or change control activities.
 Strong knowledge of applicable regulations and standards, e.g. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDR
 Good Swedish and English skills, orally and written
 Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
 Good communication skills and the ability to work well in cross-functional teams
  
 
 In addition to your technical skills, we highly value your personality. You think strategically but pragmatically and are able to make decisions. You work independently and can take quick decisions within your area of responsibility.
  
 We think you have an ambition for growth and an eagerness for keeping up to date with the latest in medical device regulations and standards.
  
 At Getinge we see ourselves as proactive and self-driven in learning and contributing to the continued development of our products and our organization's capabilities.  We are Team Players, Forward Thinkers and Game Changers.
   
 We think you will thrive in a high-expectation environment and have an interest in our products.

 If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Hiring Manager Mohammad Fazel at email: mohammad.fazel@getinge.com  or Talent Partner Emma Paulsson at emma.paulsson@getinge.com.
  
 We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

jobs.description:

Are you an experienced design engineer looking for a new challenge beyond traditional R&D work?
In this role, you will be the technical link between R&D, our suppliers, and the supply chain organization. You will use your engineering background to support supplier qualifications, contribute to technical discussions on manufacturing solutions, and ensure that our design requirements are understood and fulfilled.
This is a new role with opportunities to influence and shape how we work. With suppliers located around the world, international travel will be a natural part of your work.

Represent R&D in technical discussions and qualifications of new and existing suppliers.
Review and clarify technical requirements, drawings, and specifications together with suppliers and manufacturing teams.
Support technical evaluations and assessments of supplier capabilities.
Provide engineering support to Procurement, Supplier Quality, and internal manufacturing operations.
Contribute to improvements in component design, manufacturing processes, and supplier qualification methods.

What You Bring
A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Experience in mechanical design and product development within R&D.
Experience working with 3D CAD, technical drawings, and manufacturing documentation.
Good understanding of manufacturing processes and technical requirements.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across different technical disciplines.
Good communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.
Experience with manufacturing processes such as precision casting, machining, brazing, or coating is considered an advantage.

A curious and proactive engineer who enjoys working with people and exploring new technical challenges. You are comfortable taking responsibility, sharing your expertise, and building strong relationships with colleagues and suppliers. You enjoy combining engineering knowledge with a broader perspective on how components are manufactured and delivered.

You will join our Turbine R&D team, responsible for the design and development of hot gas path components, including turbine blades and guide vanes, as well as turbine rotors for our SGT-600, SGT-700, SGT-750, and SGT-800 gas turbines.
Our team combines deep technical expertise with an open and supportive atmosphere where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are encouraged. Colleagues help each other and work together to solve technical challenges.

Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Do you want to be a part building the next generation of platforms within fintech? Do you have solid experience in backend development and Java, and enjoy taking technical ownership? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence architecture, integrations and scalable solutions in a growing tech company? Then the role as Senior Software Engineer to Yabie could be the right opportunity for you!
About Yabie
Yabie is a Swedish fintech company that has been developing cloud-based POS systems and payment solutions since 2017. By combining payments, point-of-sale systems, sales and other features into a single platform, Yabie helps businesses simplify their daily operations and run their businesses more efficiently. Yabie continues to develop its technology and organisation to create even better and more scalable solutions.
About the role as Senior Software Engineer
As a Senior Software Engineer at Yabie, you will become an important part of the backend team and take clear ownership of developing and maintaining the systems that power Yabie's platform. Part of the role also involves expanding Yabie's API capabilities, including APIs and MCP setup, so that more partners can integrate with their solution. You will work hands-on with Java and Spring Boot, building backend services, APIs and integrations that connect Yabie's platform with partners and external systems. Your work will involve everything from designing new solutions to improving existing integrations, with a strong focus on quality, scalability and maintainability.
The tech team consists of approximately 20 people with expertise in backend development, mobile development, QA and DevOps. You will join the backend team alongside nine other backend developers. You will work closely with both the product teams and other developers, with great opportunities to influence technical solutions and ways of working.
Your main responsibilities:
Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
Design and develop integrations between Yabie, partners and external systems.
Contribute to architecture and scalable technical solutions.
Troubleshoot, optimise and improve existing services.

About you
We are looking for someone with a post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Development or a similar field, alternatively equivalent professional experience. You have approximately five or more years of experience in backend development and have worked with Java and Spring Boot in a production environment. You have solid experience in API development, REST, integrations and databases, as well as an understanding of microservices and scalable systems.
